title: Fluorine — calculated thermodynamic functions
body:
# Fluorine — calculated thermodynamic functions

<!-- generated-by: sync-thermochemistry.mjs -->

Source: SRC-000517, NIST Chemistry WebBook / Chase (1998), retrieved 2026-10-07. These are calculations from dated fits, not new measurements. Values below are rounded to four decimal places for computational comparison; this is not a statement of physical precision. Uncertainty: UNKNOWN. Basis: **mol F2**.

[Full calculation and limits](../0009-Fluorine-F-Thermochemistry.md) · [Complete 101-point-per-fit CSV](0009-Fluorine-F-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) · [Exact coefficients](../data/structured/0009-Fluorine-F-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml)

| Fit | Variant | T / K | Cp° / J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ | S° / J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ | H°(T)−H°(298.15 K) / kJ mol⁻¹ |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 298.0000 | 31.3334 | 202.7825 | -0.0038 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 3149.0000 | 37.1739 | 288.3454 | 106.8091 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 6000.0000 | 28.9941 | 309.7892 | 200.3106 |

Each row uses only the named phase and fit interval. Do not subtract rows from different phases to obtain transition enthalpy without first resolving their standard-state reference offsets.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook — molecular Fluorine F2 GAS thermochemistry (7 October 2026 SI retrieval)
sources.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope_note: Dated SI response for the existing Fluorine/F2 WebBook work SRC-000160. Preserve its original node and aliases. SRC-000159 is distinct atomic Fluorine work; this retrieval is not independent evidence or a condensed-phase source.
sources.scope: The retained species is molecular F2 GAS, CAS7782-41-4, InChI=1S/F2/c1-2. One mole of F2 molecules contains two moles of fluorine atoms; this species-count relation does not convert thermodynamic F2 functions to atomic F. Bind MAT:0009:MOL:F2 at /ordinary_molecular_state with mol F2 basis. Atomic /atomic_state lacks explicit charge=0 and /fluoride is a distinct ion. No atomic F, fluoride F-, HF, compound or equilibrium dissociation/ionisation mixture follows. The molecular closed-shell ground state and authored monoisotopic natural composition do not supply fit-resolved isotope or spin scope. One GAS Shomate column covers298–6000 K. Preserve all59 publisher rows, including raw298 K first row and its negative-zero rounded enthalpy; distinguish this printed temperature from the298.15 K published enthalpy reference. Retain the calculated reference residual; do not force zero. This one-column source has no duplicated inter-fit endpoints. No below298K/above6000K extrapolation, liquid/solid/cryogenic fluorine, fluid EOS, phase transitions, latent heat or pressure-dependent function is inferred. Preserve Chase1998, reported June1982 data review, actual2026-10-07 retrieval timestamps and private2026-10-07 software review as distinct provenance. No January2009 parameter-fit comment is printed. Shomate has no pressure variable: applied sample pressure is UNKNOWN; the separate source one-bar entropy datum does not specify arbitrary-pressure conditions or coefficient uncertainty. Coefficient uncertainty/covariance remain UNKNOWN; printed rounding and software residuals are not physical uncertainty. Independent parser and Python/JavaScript checks compare the same publisher work, not independent measurements, calorimetry, experimental replication or medical F18/PET efficacy. A dated snapshot should link same_work_as SRC-000160/SRC-F-004 while preserving its supports/aliases. SRC-000159/SRC-F-003 is distinct atomic Fluorine work.
sources.reference: Chase, M.W., Jr. (1998), NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition. June 1982 data review and October 2026 retrieval are distinct provenance.
